title: Achieving adaptivity and optimality for multi-armed bandits using Exponential-Kullback Leibler Maillard Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2502.14379v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the problem of $K$-armed bandits with reward distributions belonging to a one-parameter exponential distribution family. In the literature, several criteria have been proposed to evaluate the performance of such algorithms, including Asymptotic Optimality, Minimax Optimality, Sub-UCB, and variance-adaptive regret bound. Thompson Sampling-based and Upper Confidence Bound-based algorithms have been employed to achieve some of these criteria. However, none of these algorithms simultaneously satisfy all the aforementioned criteria.   In this paper, we design an algorithm, Exponential Kullback-LeiblerMaillard Sampling (abbrev. Exp-KL-MS), that achieves multiple optimality criteria simultaneously, including Asymptotic Optimality, minimax ratio with a $\sqrt{\ln (K)}$ factor, Sub-UCB, and a variance-adaptive regret bound. Our algorithm design follows the Minimum Empirical Divergence framework~\citep{honda2011asymptotically,maillard

translated_title: 利用指数-库尔巴克-莱布勒-马亚尔采样实现多臂老虎机的自适应性与最优性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了K臂老虎机问题，其中奖励分布属于单参数指数分布族。在现有文献中，已有多种标准被提出用于评估此类算法的性能，包括渐近最优性、极小极大最优性、Sub-UCB以及方差自适应遗憾界。基于汤普森采样的算法和基于置信上界的算法已被用于实现其中部分标准。然而，目前没有任何算法能够同时满足上述所有标准。在本文中，我们设计了一种名为指数库尔巴克-莱布勒-马亚尔采样（简称Exp-KL-MS）的算法，该算法能够同时实现多种最优性标准，包括渐近最优性、带有√ln(K)因子的极小极大比率、Sub-UCB以及方差自适应遗憾界。我们的算法设计遵循最小经验散度框架。
tldr: 本文提出了Exp-KL-MS算法，这是首个能同时满足渐近最优性、极小极大最优性（带√ln(K)因子）、Sub-UCB和方差自适应遗憾界等多种最优性标准的多臂老虎机算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Exp-KL-MS, the first multi-armed bandit algorithm that simultaneously achieves multiple optimality criteria, including asymptotic optimality, minimax optimality with a √ln(K) factor, Sub-UCB, and a variance-adaptive regret bound.
